Licence: GPLv2 ("Licence: GPLv2" in the source headers, e.g. driver/id_ata.cpp;
parts from the FreeBSD ATA driver under its BSD licence, see the headers).
The archives carry no licence text; COPYING-GPL-2.0.txt is the GPLv2 text.

Tracked: uniata.sys (Release_Dist\uniata.sys of BusMaster_v47b.rar, unmodified),
readme_w2k.txt (the author's 2000 notes), BusMaster_v47b_src.rar (the
corresponding source).

USOS use: Windows 2000 SP4 only, as the alternative to AHCINT selected with
Systems\Windows\Windows 2000\Unattended\storage-uniata.txt on DATA
(tools/w2k_stage.sh). USOS writes its own uniata.inf (the package's uata_2k.inf
lists IDE controllers only) and the TXTSETUP.SIF rows; uniata.sys is unchanged.
